editorial:
Imagine waking up from a medical trial and realizing you can hear what people are thinking. That is exactly what happens to Liza Raines in this wild ride of a movie. After a failed experiment leaves her as the only survivor, Liza finds out she has super-hearing that lets her pick up on brain frequencies. While that sounds like a dream, it quickly turns into a nightmare. The vibe is tense and mysterious, making you feel the panic as Liza realizes the people who did this to her want her dead to keep their secrets hidden. You will find yourself rooting for her as she tries to stay one step ahead of the bad guys.

What really works here is how the movie handles the tension and the unique twist on super-powers. The acting is solid, and the way the sound design plays with your ears makes the experience feel real. It might feel a bit low-budget in some spots, but the plot keeps things moving fast. If you like thrillers with a sci-fi edge, you should definitely check this out. You can rent it on Apple TV or add the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection if you want the best picture quality possible.
endingExplained: In the final act, Liza uses her hearing to outsmart the people trying to kill her. She manages to uncover the truth about the experiment and the deaths of the other patients. After a tense showdown, she uses her abilities to expose the villains and secure her safety. The movie ends with Liza accepting her new life, knowing she can never go back to being normal but finally being free from the people hunting her.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves secret government experiments and people with special powers.
